newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber untraded ahead of holiday weekend.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber untraded ahead of holiday weekend.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midsession on Friday in dull trade with most players sitting on the sidelines ahead of the long holiday weekend, dealers said.
"It was boring. The market was untraded in the morning and most people are just on the sidelines waiting for the holiday," a local rubber trader said.
The rubber market here will be closed on Monday for a holiday and will reopen on Tuesday, November 12.
"Most everybody just marked time. It was more quiet than usual. It may drift this afternoon if sentiment does not pick up," a dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, December RSS3 was indicated at 125.75 U.S. cents a kg compared with the previous 126.50 cents.
January RSS1 was indicated at 183.00 Singapore cents (US$1.30) a kg against 184.00 cents.
January TSR20 was indicated at 178.25 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg from 178.75 cents.
